name: Dockit
description: Pin your URLs. A shared home page for the tools your team actually opens — Grafana, Proxmox, GitLab, the firewall, the wiki — organised by space, category and card. Self-hosted on Unraid. One JSON file in appdata, no database. Backup = copy the folder. Local login always works; LDAP / AD and OIDC (Keycloak, Authentik, Authelia) are optional.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: portal.json, curation and uploaded assets. Writable by PUID:PGID (default 99:100). Backup this folder.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User id that owns appdata. Unraid nobody is 99. Leave at 99 unless you know you need another uid.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group id that owns appdata. Unraid users is 100.

variables.name: Edit password
variables.description: Required. 12 characters or more. First login is this password for user admin (or Edit user below).

variables.name: Public origin
variables.description: Public URL if behind a reverse proxy, e.g. https://portal.example. Leave empty on the LAN.

variables.name: Trust proxy
variables.description: Set to 1 when behind a reverse proxy so Dockit honours X-Forwarded-* headers.

variables.name: OIDC client secret
variables.description: Optional. If set, the SSO secret is not stored in portal.json. Otherwise paste it in Dockit Settings.

variables.name: LDAP bind password
variables.description: Optional. One bind password for every directory. Different accounts: leave this empty and use PORTAL_LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD_ID, or paste in Settings.
